top: ...man doth not live by bread only,
bottom: but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD...

top: Thou shalt open thine hand wide
bottom: unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy...

top: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet
And when we cried unto the LORD...
bottom: the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction...

top: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God:
bottom: but those things which are revealed belong unto us...
and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life...
